items.title: Shipping forecast updated as of 13 November 2026 4:15am
items.description:
##Current shipping forecast##

Valid for 24 HoursIssued on Friday, 13 November 2026 at 4:15am by Ronaldsway Met Office
##Warning##

Nil.


##Synopsis##

Low pressure near Iceland and high pressure covering much of the British Isles.


##Wind##

North or northwest, backing west or northwest through the morning, 3 or 4, backing southwest 4 or 5 later in the evening.


##State of Sea##

Slight.


##Weather##

Fair at first, then isolated showers quickly developing.


##Visibility##

Good, perhaps moderate in showers.


##Outlook for the following 24 hours##


##Wind##

Southwest 4 or 5, quickly backing south or southwest 5 or 6, increasing 7 for a time later.


##State of Sea##

Slight, quickly becoming mainly moderate, becoming moderate or rough later.


##Weather##

Occasional showers becoming isolated in the afternoon.


##Visibility##

Good, falling moderate in showers.
